description: This file defines a class 'HttpContext' that wraps a Vert.x 'RoutingContext' and implements the 'ExecutionContext' interface to provide request-scoped context management and tracing capabilities within an HTTP handling service.

classes.name: HttpContext
classes.description: Represents the context for a Vert.x HTTP request, wrapping the RoutingContext and managing tracing context (SpanContext).

methods.name: HttpContext
methods.description: Constructor that initializes HttpContext with a RoutingContext, ensuring it is not null.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a value associated with the specified key from the RoutingContext.

methods.name: get (overloaded)
methods.description: Retrieves a value associated with the key or returns the provided default if absent.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the RoutingContext.
